about.title: About Me
about.content: I am a motivated student pursuing a degree in Informatics at POLITEKNIK NEGERI BATAM, skilled in HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Laravel, and React JS. I have hands-on experience in web development, video production, audio production, and graphic design. I completed a trainee program focused on software testing and web application projects. Detail-oriented and a strong team player, I am seeking an internship in Full-Stack Web Development to further hone my skills.
